title: Stunning Benalmadena Marina Apartments for sale with sea views
summary: Located between the towns of Torremolinos and Fuengirola, and just 20 minutes from Malaga airport and connected to the rest of the coast by train and bus services, these luxury Benalmadena Marina apartments offer sweeping views and bright and modern spaces.
description:
Located between the towns of Torremolinos and Fuengirola, and just 20 minutes from Malaga airport and connected to the rest of the coast by train and bus services, these luxury Benalmadena Marina apartments offer sweeping views and bright and modern spaces.

Inspired by its maritime surroundings and perfectly situated to optimise the panoramic views, this brand new development in Benalmadena offers nautical-themed architecture with apartments that radiate contemporary warmth and sophistication. You are greeted by an abundance of natural light that floods through the expansive windows, creating a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere. The spacious bright interiors are enhanced with high quality finishes and all the rooms offer elegant and welcoming spaces designed to offer homeowners a modern and comfortable lifestyle.

Situated in a prime location next to Benalmadena’s emblematic marina, often rated one of the best in the world, the complex offers beautiful communal areas designed to blend with the natural surroundings and the swimming pool area is planted with shrubs and tropical plants, providing a sense of relaxation.

Benalmadena is a lively coastal town perfectly situated within easy reach of Malaga city centre and other towns along the coast, including Fuengirola and Marbella, making it one of the most popular destinations on the Costa del Sol. There is so much on offer for visitors and residents alike, with around 10 km of beautiful beaches, shopping centres and a whole host of exciting activities for everyone, including excellent golf courses, a casino and nature parks including Paloma Park, where you can take a peaceful stroll through the beautifully maintained park or sit and enjoy a quiet picnic. Just a 10-minute drive from these apartments is the whitewashed mountain village of Benalmadena Pueblo, known for its beautiful, cobbled streets, traditional Andalusian architecture and charming squares.

With something for the whole family to enjoy, these Benalmadena apartments and penthouses are the ideal place to relax and enjoy all that this captivating location has to offer. Perhaps this is the ideal setting to enjoy Mediterranean living as a full-time resident or a holiday home!

Prices from € 332.000 to 1.492.000
